title: Error Chains
concept: Error chains wrap lower-level errors with context from each layer — creating a trail from root cause to surface symptom.
why: A database timeout in a web request: 'connection refused' tells you nothing. 'user lookup failed: db timeout after 30s: connection refused at 10.0.1.5:5432' tells you everything.
tips: Wrap low-level errors with domain context at each layer
Use the ? operator for automatic error propagation — less boilerplate, clearer code
Each wrapper should ADD context ("user lookup failed" + db error) not just re-wrap
Display error chains from outermost to innermost — surface symptom to root cause
common_mistakes: Losing the original error when wrapping — always preserve the source error
Wrapping without adding context — the wrapper should add information, not just rename
Swallowing errors at the wrong level — propagate until something can handle it
